payload.summary: Tools truncation: the description clamp and six-column launcher grid are still present
payload.detail: REVIEW 2026-09-25 (offline audit of current main; no provider access): Both remain (tools-search-results-page.tsx line-clamp-2; applications-launcher-page.tsx xl:grid-cols-6). Provenance correction: the clamp existed when the file was created in c0364b790; PR #2317 moved it rather than reintroducing it. PRIOR DETAIL: Two distinct instances. (a) tools-search-results-page.tsx:141 line-clamp-2 on tool descriptions, added by PR #2317 on 2026-08-23, five weeks after the July audit removed exactly that clamp; bites at 320/390. (b) applications-launcher-page.tsx:287 xl:grid-cols-6 packs six category tiles into a ~780px column at 1440/1920, truncating titles ('Ask evi...', 'Prescri...') and breaking descriptions mid-word ('prescribin/g'); clean at 768. Dropping the xl step fixes (b).
